description.value: The study examined whether healthy aging is associated with altered segregation of the visual word network and its connectivity with other brain regions, and whether these connectivity changes relate to visual word-perception performance.

spans.text: This study aimed to investigate whether there is a specific decline in word perception among healthy older adults compared with young adults.

design.value: The study compared healthy older and young adults using resting-state and task fMRI, a block-designed word localizer, and behavioral word- and symbol-form matching tasks.

spans.text: This study first collected resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) data from all participants in a quiet state. Subsequently, task fMRI data were acquired, during which participants judged the direction of a word picture shown on the screen (left or right).
